name: NIPPON KANZAI Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: NIPPON KANZAI Holdings Co.,Ltd. manages and operates buildings in Japan and is also involved in energy saving, environmental work, residential management and real estate fund management. It runs public facilities such as water supply, sewage and waste plants, manages condominiums, and provides security, staffing, payroll outsourcing and consulting. Chuo is its headquarters, and it was incorporated in 2023.
